name: Switch views and read the scale disclosure
description: Validates the view switch and that the note under the 3D view always states how much larger than life the scene is drawn.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024 and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state ready
Assert the note under the view (data-testid scale-note) contains "Depth is drawn 20 times deeper" and "the anchor 30 times"
In the view switch (data-testid view-switch), click "At the cut"
Assert a "Seabed detail" switch with "Measured" and "Illustrated" appears, "Illustrated" is pressed, and the note contains "the anchor is drawn 2 times its size"
Click "Measured" in the Seabed detail switch
Assert the note contains "only the depth grid under the cut"
Click "From above" in the view switch
Assert the Seabed detail switch is gone, "From above" is pressed, and the note again contains "Depth is drawn 20 times deeper"
